stateChanges.title: [Bug] Project actions menu: Auto-discover dev server runs the first saved action instead of discovering a server

en.headline: 18 own commits, 15 automated commits, and one issue interaction
en.summary: In `openchamber/openchamber`, `btriapitsyn` closed issue #5293, titled "[Bug] Project actions menu: Auto-discover dev server runs the first saved action instead of discovering a server". The opened-or-closed issue count was **1**; the recorded activity was a comment by `sogeisetsu` on `sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu` issue #8, "[ai-failure] AI 叙述生成失败", which had 5 comments at collection time. The day included **18 own commits** plus 15 automated commits by `github-actions[bot]`, with no pull requests or reviews recorded. In `sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu`, 11 own commits added `opencode-go-minimax` as the free AI provider leg, changed it to send `reasoning_effort=low`, refreshed code-map baselines through `d93ea4d`, and used then removed temporary CI probe workflows. In `sogeisetsu/sopen-translate`, 6 own commits created an MV3 extension with page translation, removed selection translation, added page-state resets and required-field validation, introduced JSDoc type checking and DOM smoke tests, and added `AGENTS.md`. The remaining own commit updated `sogeisetsu/opencode-agent-sandbox` documentation with the `openchamber-storage` category and its paste, deletion, and `VACUUM` procedures.

zh.headline: 18 次本人提交、15 次自动提交及 1 个 issue 互动
zh.summary: 在 `openchamber/openchamber` 中，`btriapitsyn` 关闭了 issue #5293，标题为“[Bug] Project actions menu: Auto-discover dev server runs the first saved action instead of discovering a server”。新开或关闭的 issue 计数为 **1**；记录的活动是 `sogeisetsu` 在 `sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu` 的 issue #8“[ai-failure] AI 叙述生成失败”下发表评论，采集时该 issue 共 5 条评论。当天有 **18 次本人提交**，另有 15 次由 `github-actions[bot]` 自动提交，未记录 pull request 或 review。在 `sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu` 中，11 次本人提交将 `opencode-go-minimax` 加入免费 AI 供应商链路，改为发送 `reasoning_effort=low`，将代码映射基线更新至 `d93ea4d`，并临时使用后删除 CI 探针 workflow。在 `sogeisetsu/sopen-translate` 中，6 次本人提交创建了支持页面翻译的 MV3 扩展，移除选区翻译，加入页面状态重置、必填校验、JSDoc 类型检查和 DOM 冒烟测试，并新增 `AGENTS.md`。其余本人提交为 `sogeisetsu/opencode-agent-sandbox` 的文档增加了 `openchamber-storage` 类别，以及粘贴、删除和 `VACUUM` 流程说明。
